snippet.title: Netherworld Covenant 1.0: Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
A Complete Evolution — The Final Covenant Begins!
Developed by MadGoat Game Studio and published by Infini Fun, the dark fantasy action roguelike Netherworld Covenant will officially launch its Version 1.0 on December 9 via Steam and the Epic Games Store.
